groups.name: Intent view rendering
groups.rationale: Introduces the new component that renders what the change is for at the top of the page.
groups.watch: The markup is pure HTML generation without a DOM; it must escape user input perfectly to prevent XSS through intents and commit subjects.

groups.name: Commit subject extraction
groups.rationale: Extracts commit subjects from the branch to corroborate the stated intent.
groups.watch: The git log format string and commit filtering must correctly capture only commits on the branch, not shared ancestors.

groups.name: Session data contract
groups.rationale: Extends the session data structure to carry intents and commits through the API and storage layers.
groups.watch: The optional `commits` field in `SessionRound` must be handled gracefully for older rounds without it; untrusted input in the server must be validated.

groups.name: Server API and data serving
groups.rationale: Threads intents and commits through the server: parsing incoming requests, storing rounds, and serving the data endpoint.
groups.watch: The `stringList` utility must handle any untrusted value gracefully; the data endpoint must include both fields in its response.

groups.name: CLI and diff extraction integration
groups.rationale: Passes extracted commit subjects from the diff command through to the session creation.
groups.watch: The commits field must propagate correctly from extraction through the command to the request payload.

groups.name: HTML template and server-side rendering
groups.rationale: Renders the intent view in the initial HTML so the stated reason is never blank on page load.
groups.watch: The intent band must be placed before the diff in the grid layout and properly escaped; it must handle sessions with no rounds.

groups.name: Browser DOM and client-side rendering
groups.rationale: Mounts the intent view in the browser and updates it when a new round arrives.
groups.watch: The intent must be re-rendered when a session event arrives, so the viewer always sees the reason for the current round.

groups.name: Layout and styling
groups.rationale: Adds a new grid row for the intent band and styles it to stay visible while long diffs scroll.
groups.watch: The max-height cap and overflow handling must prevent a long intent list from drowning out the review; the empty state must hide the band entirely.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
